newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Oct crude exports reach 1.66 mln bpd -Pemex.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Oct crude exports reach 1.66 mln bpd -Pemex.

text.p: Mexico's October crude oil exports averaged 1.66 million barrels per day (bpd), state- owned oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) reported Thursday.
Pemex said average crude exports reached 1.55 million bpd for the first ten months of the year.
Of these exports, the company said it sold abroad an average 190,300 bpd of Isthmus, 874,100 bpd of Maya and 487,800 bpd of Olmeca.

For the first ten months of the year, 78 percent of Mexico's crude oil exports by volume went to the United States, 7.8 percent to other areas in the Americas, 6.4 percent was sent to Spain, six percent went to the Far East and 2.8 percent was shipped to Europe.
